No. 1: OPENING CHORUS & SOLO (Samuel)
"Pour, oh pour, the pirate sherry"

MIDI File [14KB, 1' 40"]

SCENE. – A rocky sea-shore on the coast of Cornwall. Groups of pirates discovered.

Chorus. Pour, oh pour, the pirate sherry;
Fill, oh fill, the pirate glass;
And, to make us more than merry,
Let the pirate bumper pass.
Samuel. For to-day our pirate 'prentice
Rises from indentures freed;
Strong his arm and keen his scent is,
He's a pirate now indeed!
All. Here's good luck to Fred'ric's ventures!
Fred'ric's out of his indentures.
(FREDERIC rises and comes forward with PIRATE KING.)
